question: Where did haunted houses come from?
notes: Narration v3. Times are seconds into voice.mp3, computed from words.json by shots.py. Each scene is one stop on the vertical paper strip. "paint" lists where the paint lands and the word it lands on.

scenes.line: Where did haunted houses come from?

art.desc: A tall, narrow, slightly crooked old house with one lit window

scenes.line: The usual story puts them in the Depression, when towns wanted to keep kids from wrecking things on Halloween.

art.desc: A kid on tiptoe scribbling on a shop window with a bar of soap

scenes.line: But old newspapers say the idea is older.

art.desc: A tall, narrow, slightly crooked old house with one lit window

scenes.line: In 1915, a church youth class in South Dakota turned their minister's house into "A Haunted House."

art.desc: A small country church and, beside it, the minister's house

scenes.line: Guests were sent, two at a time, up "the stairway that leads to death." At the top, a ghost pounced.

art.desc: Two guests climbing narrow stairs side by side; a sheet ghost at the top

scenes.beat_note: No paint on the ghost or the guests.

scenes.line: Another party plan had guests touch a dead man's "brains" in the dark: an ice-cold sponge.

art.desc: A hand reaching in the dark toward a plate holding a round sponge

scenes.beat_note: No paint: red here would read as gore.

art.desc: Two peeled grapes on a saucer

scenes.line: Later, in the Depression, pranks got rough,

art.desc: A garden gate pulled off its posts, a toppled flowerpot

scenes.line: so some towns threw big parties instead.

art.desc: Five kids in homemade costumes at a table with a punch bowl, streamers above

scenes.line: In Fargo, the paper's headline afterward: "Halloween Damage Light."

art.desc: A neat, unbroken picket fence with its gate shut

scenes.line: Then people found another use for a haunted house: raising money.

art.desc: An old admission ticket and two coins

scenes.line: Decades later, a volunteer women's group in Indianapolis sold tickets to one in an old building,

art.desc: Four people waiting at the arched door of an old building
A jar with coins and paper bills

scenes.line: Then clubs around the country started running their own, for charity.

art.desc: Three small houses, each with a paper ghost in the window

scenes.line: So decades before that Indianapolis fundraiser, a church party was sending guests upstairs to meet a ghost.

art.desc: A sheet ghost at the top of a short staircase, arms raised

paint.on: a lower step, beside the ghost
